tasks.title: Improve the home page UI/UX
tasks.checkResult:
Fully redesigned the MeetRoom home page from a bare 8-line placeholder into a complete, polished multi-section landing page.

Changes made:

home.html (413 lines):
- Hero section: full-viewport dark background with SVG cityscape, animated availability badge, large headline with accent color, subtitle, dual CTA buttons (Browse Rooms / My Reservations), stats bar (12+ rooms, 50+ capacity, 24/7 booking), scroll hint
- How It Works: 3-step cards (Browse, Pick a Date, Confirm & Meet) with SVG icons; middle card features dark highlight treatment
- Featured Spaces: 3 room cards with illustrated SVG images, capacity badge, feature tags (Wi-Fi, Video Call, 4K Display, etc.), reserve buttons, hover lift effect; "Most Popular" badge on first card
- Everything You Need: 8 amenity cards in 4-col grid with SVG icons (Wi-Fi, Video, Whiteboard, Catering, Displays, Mobile, Security, Flexible Hours)
- CTA Strip: red background with bold call-to-action and arrow button
- Rich footer: brand, tagline, social links, navigation, room types, contact info, bottom bar

header.html: Fixed position with backdrop-blur, brand name with red accent span, "Book a Room" CTA button in nav

style.css: 870+ lines of new CSS — all sections styled with transitions, hover states, responsive breakpoints at 991px and 767px

Assets created: hero-bg.svg (architectural cityscape), room-1.svg, room-2.svg, room-3.svg (conference room illustrations)
